description: Read the app's log, or with source crashes its crash, ANR and exit reports. Returns, for the log, its own lines (logcat on Android), newest last, secrets redacted; level, contains, limit (200). For crashes: a bounded summary and each report's file; limit (5), symbols. An action the app died under already says why: this is for more. Requests: capture_network.

since.description: ISO time; default: since the last action

symbols.description: a .dSYM or folder of them; Android: a folder of .so

name: read_logs
title: Logs and crashes
